1.2.3.8-r1.burton_quote: a moth of the soul, a consumption, to make another man’s happiness his misery, to torture, crucify and execute himself, to eat his own heart. Meat and drink can do such men no good, they do always grieve, sigh and groan, day and night without intermission, their breast is torn asunder

1.2.3.8-r2.burton_quote: like the Frog in Aesop, that would swell till she was as big as an Ox, burst herself at last
